delivery.title: Delivery Center
delivery.subtitle: Portfolio by health and predictability, Delivery 360, missions, validation, and human acceptance.
delivery.capabilityUnavailable: Detailed traceability is temporarily unavailable. The delivery summary remains accessible.

portfolio.title: Delivery Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Deliveries by health and predictability.
portfolio.configureHint: Owner and date are derived from persisted operational signals for this delivery.

planning.title: Plan {{name}}
planning.explain: This action updates the delivery owner and committed date and stores the forecast in an auditable history. Signals and Delivery 360 are recalculated from those persisted facts.
planning.ownerHint: Only agents assigned to this project.
planning.forecastDateHint: Current forecast. Each change creates a new history record without deleting the previous one.
planning.noAgents: No agent is assigned to the project. Configure the project team before saving.
planning.error: Could not save. Check that the delivery has active operational signals and try again.

plan.title: Plan & milestones
plan.insufficient: Insufficient evidence — the Delivery Forecast never invents a date.

trace.noNextSteps: No pending item can be derived from current data.

sources.portfolioSource: Persisted projects, missions, documents, attempts and forecast history.
sources.portfolioCalculation: Owner = most frequent agent on open missions; milestones = completed/total obligations; health and attention = deterministic read-model rules.
sources.overviewSource: Delivery read model combined with persisted project resources.
sources.overviewCalculation: Health, milestones, blockers and predictability derive from real missions, documents, decisions, dependencies and attempts.
sources.forecastSource: Append-only forecast history and current delivery state.
sources.forecastCalculation: Forecast weighs committed date, throughput and historical variance; without sufficient evidence, no date is invented.
sources.ownerMissing: No open mission has an assigned owner.
sources.dateMissing: No target date has been declared.
sources.forecastMissing: There is no reliable forecast yet.
sources.forecastEvidenceMissing: Not enough history or workload data to calculate a date.

signals.committedDateRisk: The committed date is at risk.
signals.noOwner: No owner can be derived for this delivery.
signals.noRecentUpdate: The delivery has no recent update.

milestones.title: Milestones progress
milestones.caption: {{done}} of {{total}} milestones completed.
milestones.empty: No milestones defined for this delivery.

features.title: Attempts by feature
features.empty: No attempt data by feature yet.

forecast.caption: Confidence of each recalculation over time (0–100%).

guidance.tight: The agreed deadline is close to the expected end of the work: it fits, but with no slack.
